name: long side rail
explanation: Forms the long side of the bed frame and supports the slatted bed base.

name: slatted bed base
explanation: Provides the flexible sleeping surface that supports the mattress.

name: headboard/end frame
explanation: Closes one end of the bed and provides the headboard structure.

name: footboard/end frame
explanation: Closes the opposite end of the bed and helps stabilize the frame.
